name: wax-seal-stamp
title: Wax Seal Stamp
description: An initials monogram pressed into a wax disc: radial-gradient wax with irregular blob edge (border-radius trick), debossed lettering via inner shadows, and a press animation on click that re-stamps the seal.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Luxury
Macrostructure: Stack
Density: Dense
Shape: Soft
Motion: Subtle
Typography: Serif Display
Color: Muted Earth

## Rules

- Click Restamp: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
